author: DJ_Gekko24
quote: Honestly I love Pikmin, but the switch 2 upgrade wasn’t worth it.  The additional content is mediocre at best and the lack of a performance upgrade makes me wonder what’s even the point.  I hope Nintendo addresses this but until then I’d say Pikmin 4 for switch 2 has got me underwhelmed.
game_title: Pikmin 4: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy

author: DJ_Gekko24
quote: Game is too buggy for the budget and amount of time dedicated to making it.  The studio clearly had a different path they wanted to go with this game but it wasn’t what fans of the franchise wanted.  Clipping through the floor, floating objects, game crashing constantly, and so much more.  The game needed more time and polish but didn’t get it, yet people will die on the hill that it’s perfect, it’s not.  Not to mention the story and bland and boring compared to other entries in the series.  It’s pure hype and nothing else.  The game is a failure by the standards created by rockstar’s other entries in the franchise.

author: DJ_Gekko24
quote: Honestly such a fresh take on the series and sure it may have its flaws, but it’s an AMAZING start to a new era for Sonic games going forward!  The soundtrack is a major rock fest and it’s so great to just listen to the OST!  The combat feels great and fun, the open world is huge and it’s so satisfying just to run throughout it!
